record.method: Separate Python FCFF calculation; compensated term-by-term continuation sum; linear whole-year search; 100-digit Decimal.from_float precision-boundary recurrence.
record.precisionBoundaryMethod: 100-digit arithmetic on exact binary input rates and the returned frozen explicit/terminal PV components; repeated annual multiplication. This isolates the horizon boundary from financial-engine rounding and independently verifies regression years. precision_limit is a conservative output policy, not an assertion that no exact-real-number solution exists.

record.scope: All six presets, nine named arithmetic/boundary cases, 24 seeded valid cases and six additional Decimal precision fixtures. No source data, financial forecasts or probabilities are independently validated by this check.

record.method: Independent 100-digit Decimal.from_float share issuance ledger starting with 100 existing shares; inverse ceiling derived by pricing the maximum new share count at the requested floor.
record.comparisonPolicy: At-floor uses 32 IEEE-754 epsilon times max(retained fraction, floor); a 100% floor permits exactly zero primary capital, so any positive issuance breaches it even when retained ownership rounds to one.

record.method: Independent 100-digit Decimal.from_float explicit FCFF and direct annual finite-continuation sum; Fraction.from_float 100-existing-share issuance ledger; exhaustive listed-scenario comparisons; inverse price bound derived from allowable new share count.
record.crossoverPrecision: Exact binary entered quote and raise terms, before pre+raise or post-raise rounding; Fraction roots round once to binary64. Unresolved slope/forward-reconciliation policy is checked separately.
record.comparisonPolicy: 32 binary64 epsilons relative; positive issuance always fails a 100% retention floor. Regrets within the allocation comparison band normalize to zero. Scenario counts are not probabilities.
